learning_outcomes.text: Learn the development of Occupational Health in the world and in Türkiye.
Knows the risk factors (Physical, Chemical, Biological, Psychosocial) that threaten employees.
Takes proactive measures against work accidents in workplaces.
Takes proactive measures against occupational diseases in the workplace.
Knows the principles of health and safety in workplaces
Have knowledge about Personal Protective Equipment required for employees.
